---
title: "Lecture library"
subtitle: "Every lecture of ES 114 Probability, statistics and data visualization, January to April 2025, with its slides, notebooks, cheat sheet and short videos."
aliases:
  - schedule.html
---

Each row is one lecture, grouped by part of the course. The notebooks are from
[psdv-teaching](https://github.com/nipunbatra/psdv-teaching), which has the source code for the lectures and
[all rendered notebooks](https://nipunbatra.github.io/psdv-teaching/notebooks.html). Recordings of the tutorials
are in a [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CAzR00au0T0&list=PLftoLyLEwECCTFpc8_-gV8NqG_LgdL3Uy&index=1).
The Shorts are also collected, in course order, on the
[Probability and statistics in 1 minute](https://nipunbatra.github.io/psdv-in-1-minute.html) page and in a
[YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLc_dUTLURe5w).

[**Slides**: chapter slides from *Introduction to Probability for Data Science* and handwritten notes from class (PDF) ·
**Notebooks**: worked code, or a Colab notebook for a lab · **Apps**: interactive demos ·
**Cheat sheet**: a two-page A4 summary (PDF) · **Shorts**: one-minute videos, each answering one question; point at a
number to see the question · **Videos**: explainers by others (point at one to see its author) · **Recording**: a tutorial video by the instructor.]{.res-key}

::: {.lecture-library}
